rationale: PINS JSX component usage as the canonical RENDERS relation (2026-10-18: RelationshipType.Renders landed in src/ast/types.ts df5a03eb2; the row was `uses` before because no canonical value existed). Source = the enclosing symbol, target = the component tag name. One row per JSX ELEMENT: the paired <Panel>…</Panel> emits exactly ONE renders row (pinned by expectRelationshipCount equals:1) while its nested self-closing <Button/> is its own element; lowercase intrinsics (div, span) and fragments emit nothing. Pre-fix (2022 J8 era) JSX emitted nothing at all, then emitted `uses`; the name rule is unchanged, only the label moved.
